I'll start by reading TASK.md and brief.md so I follow the brief exactly, with section 0 taking priority.Section 0 points at the T3j and T5 rules plus a correction round. I’ll read those rules, the prior review, and the existing work before changing anything.The review rejects the previous run on the mode flag, custom sizes, traces, acceptance, and the manifest. I’ll read the current result and the scripts that produced it before adding a new experiment.The prior run left the mode flag outside owned RAM and never entered the custom-size page. I’ll pull the exact menu strings and free-byte check from the existing logs, then add one new measurement run.The mode flag sits below the owned range, and the custom-size page is the menu screen with a C1 row that was never opened. I’ll measure that page and the missing traces before changing the hook.The first measurement found a custom-size write, but the open trace missed the direct screen because the still/movie switch ran first. I’ll inspect those frames, then rerun the trace without that switch.The size editor writes `0x1dd1` indices 2 and 3 through the same setter, and the stock direct screen can show C1. I’ll move the mode flag into the owned tail and route that editor with one new hook.The correction round is recorded in `work/result.md` and `work/evidence-manifest.json`. The acceptance run did not finish `ok:true`.

What did land:

- The mode flag is `0xa031eef7`, inside the owned tail. The old byte `0xa031e91f` is outside that range and is not used. The 55-byte mirror at `0xa031eeb0` is unchanged. `0x1de1` and `0x1df1` occupy the next 16 bytes.
- The stock custom-size editor is AF Target Mode Settings. OK writes `0x1dd1` indices 2 and 3 (and the current-size pair). The stock C1 direct-screen frame is `work/out/stock-gaps-f2-11-custom-direct-hold.png`. Open and cancel traces start before the key, and the 20000-call cap was not hit.
- On the candidate, the same up, dial, right, and MENU keys wrote the profile, left the half-press cells unchanged, cleared the flag, and matched the All and Single title hashes. That is the MENU-parity amendment. The earlier `accept-e3` cancel failure stays a failed record.

The run stopped at the next normal dial. The flag was clear and the title was Single, and the dial also stepped position from 526 to 529 because the zone byte was still the profile value 1. Restoring the half-press change index into `0xa031e920` on exit is the change that removes that disagreement. It is not in this round: the four experiment versions are `stock_gaps_f1`, `stock_gaps_f2`, `route_f2`, and `accept_f3`.

C1 selection, the AF-ON custom-size edit, the OK and S1 exits, the second candidate, the candidate save, and the reopen check did not run. The control’s own menu leave did append a posted M save from `0x60061268`. One orientation only. Subject Detect stayed off. No firmware image and no new section 6 or 7 byte.Those four runs are already in `work/result.md` and `work/evidence-manifest.json`.

The stock open, cancel, and custom-size measurements completed. The AF-ON route stopped because the zone title had not been drawn yet. The acceptance run then matched MENU parity and the All and Single titles, and stopped on the next normal dial: the zone byte was still the profile value, so position stepped from 526 to 529. The acceptance did not finish `ok:true`.
